'Primetime' focuses on the hit show 'To Catch a Predator' and it's star Chris Hansen. Does Doug think it captures the uncomfortable nature of the series?

Check out our store - https://channelawesome.myshopify.com/

Primetime is a 2026 American psychological crime thriller film directed by Lance Oppenheim in his narrative feature film debut. Based on the 2007 Esquire article "Tonight on Dateline This Man Will Die", the film follows the production of the reality television series To Catch a Predator. Robert Pattinson stars as series host Chris Hansen, and also serves as a producer.Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, and Phoebe Bridgers play supporting roles.
